message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin together. mfa:admin blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so neither admin_dc nor admin_adfs can become true. With those states unreachable, mfa:dbadmin blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-server credential-leak path open; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administration; segmented alone can be bypassed by escalating an unpatched workstation or laptop. Any single patch or mfa:user leaves a phishing-based path through internal authentication, credential theft, and DC or ADFS administration."}
